metadata.title: DevNet SA4 Set B authored additions
metadata.note: Twelve new single-answer questions authored from the answer topics in the implementation plan. The supplied question-bank JSON does not contain the class-export stems or choices.

items.question: Which Cisco tool provides a PowerShell interface for managing Cisco UCS infrastructure?
items.explanation: UCS PowerTool provides PowerShell cmdlets for automating Cisco UCS management.

items.question: Which capability is most directly associated with Cisco Webex?
items.explanation: Cisco Webex provides collaboration capabilities for messaging and meetings.

items.question: Which Cisco Catalyst Center API category lets applications automate network operations using higher-level network intents?
items.explanation: Catalyst Center Intent APIs provide programmatic access to network tasks organized around operational intent.

items.question: Which API can developers use to control and integrate with Cisco collaboration room and desk devices?
items.explanation: Cisco collaboration endpoints expose xAPI for device control, configuration, and integrations.

items.question: Which Ansible components provide reusable operations that playbooks invoke on managed hosts?
items.explanation: Ansible modules perform discrete tasks on managed hosts and are invoked by playbooks.

items.question: Which Cisco API provides capabilities for managing and integrating with Webex room devices?
items.explanation: The Webex Devices API supports integrations with Webex collaboration devices.

items.question: Which Cisco platform provides cloud-managed networking for access points and switches?
items.explanation: Cisco Meraki provides cloud-based management for networking devices.

items.question: Which environments are common fits for Cisco Meraki deployments?
choices: Carrier core routing and long-haul transport
items.explanation: Cloud-managed Meraki networks are commonly used across distributed retail sites and conference environments.

items.question: Which Cisco Umbrella API is intended for investigating domain and IP reputation data?
items.explanation: The Umbrella Investigate API provides investigation data for domains, IP addresses, and related indicators.

items.question: Which feature lets developers customize the user interface on Cisco collaboration devices?
items.explanation: UI Extensions let developers add custom controls and experiences to supported collaboration device interfaces.

items.question: Which data modeling language defines structured configuration and state data for network devices?
items.explanation: YANG is a data modeling language for representing configuration and state data used with network management protocols.

items.question: Which message format is commonly associated with SOAP web services?
items.explanation: SOAP messages are XML-based and follow the SOAP envelope structure.
